g.text: AIR SEPARATION VPSA VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
AIR SEPARATION VPSA — TWO-BED ZEOLITE 5A O2 UNIT
1. Flags: OTS design point, cycle averages over one full cycle (model, noise off). Gas flow Nm3/h; pressure bar a; O2 mol %.
2. One bed adsorbs while the other is evacuated; the XV pattern of KS-140 (8 steps) decides which line each bed uses.
3. Purge 13 flows only in steps 2 and 6 (40 Nm3/h). Lines 14 and 15 carry gas both ways (equalisation and purge).
4. PSVs, limit switches, trips, drains and vents: see P&ID PSA-PID-001/002. Sizes: V-100 20, V-102 50, V-103 50 m3; bed 1.91 x 5.64 m.
